description: Speakers at ETGovernment Viksit Madhya Pradesh Conclave 2026, stressed that the next phase of digital governance depends on responsible deployment, integrated data systems and inclusive access to technology.
body_lead: As Madhya Pradesh accelerates its digital transformation journey, the next phase of governance must move beyond digitising services to building inclusive, AI-powered and citizen-centric public systems, according to experts at the ET Government Viksit Madhya Pradesh Conclave 2026.
